query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cards` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`cardType` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`frontImageUrl` varchar(1000),
	`frontImageKey` varchar(500),
	`backImageUrl` varchar(1000),
	`backImageKey` varchar(500),
	`extractedData` json,
	`manualData` json,
	`tags` json,
	`notes` text,
	`isFavorite` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`isArchived` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`ocrStatus` enum('pending','processing','completed','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
	`ocrError` text,
	`ocrCompletedAt` timestamp,
	`lineMessageId` varchar(255),
	`viewCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`lastViewedAt` timestamp,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `cards_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
